description: Public curled-edge quality and maximum point-length contracts with explicit disabled and geometry controls.

mutants.description: Disable the 40 percent projected-coverage gate. The 7 mm nearby curled line must no longer match the disabled control while the 20 mm line remains above-threshold, so the paired coverage oracle fails.
Ignore curled height when creating artificial distance. The full nearby line must lose its exact 100 speed and 0.1 overlap changes.
Raise the positive maximum-length gate above the 4 mm request. The nonempty 12 mm public estimate must retain four points, <=4 mm segments, and its 12 mm total length.
